status: Local scheduling regression fixed; production Reedline validation remains open.
runtime: Native Alchemy workerd, R2 and Queue with real Effect Clock; no mocked bindings, frozen time or altered guest timeout.

assertions: Acknowledged write offset is six bytes before the two-second response budget.
Guest consumes all six reply bytes before its unchanged real deadline.
Guest exits zero and publishes exactly the query plus cursor-ready marker.

limits: The controlled delay reproduces the feeder scheduling defect, not the complete production network path.
Production Reedline, rendered terminal behavior and production latency/billing comparisons remain unproved.
The activity window increases R2 polling while terminal output is active; actual production request counts and cost are not measured.

benchmark.scope: Native local workerd warm workloads; SDK compilation overlapped the beginning of this run and the shared host was not isolated. No before/after latency, R2 request-cost or production performance claim is made.
